title: Southeast Asia’s data center boom leaned on Chinese demand. New U.S. rules put that pipeline at risk
summary_full: The rules require data centers in Southeast Asia to seek U.S. approval to buy advanced AI chips, threatening to slow a build-out fueled heavily on Chinese demand.
